- `primary` action (the one big CTA)
- `secondary` actions (0-2 buttons, outline variant)
- `overflow` (3-dot menu for rare actions)
- `tabs` (inline tab row baked into the header)
- `meta` (count or last-updated timestamp, right-aligned below title)

### **PART D: ROOT CAUSE PATTERN**

The duplicate pattern emerges in TWO scenarios:

**Pattern 1: Tabbed Pages with Section Components**
- Parent page renders `PageHeader` with primary CTA (top-right)
- Parent page includes `PageTabs` (below header)
- Tab content delegates to a child component (e.g., `CampaignsHub`)
- Child component ALSO renders its own section-level header with the same CTA
- **Result:** Two identical CTAs visible when user lands on tab

**Pattern 2: Gallery/List Pages with Integrated Toolbar**
- Parent component manages multiple "views" (gallery vs. new-form)
- Gallery view renders both a toolbar-level "New" button AND invokes child gallery component
- Child gallery component ALSO renders "New" button in its own toolbar
- **Result:** Two CTAs in same visual area depending on filter/view state
